subject: ack_d_111118_fem_mux_off_local_dest
body:
ACK D 111118 FEM mux onto pack UI. Absorbed. A restamped 01/02/20 20:15.

FACT (not PASS):
- r2_top: mux onto mig_ui_bram; mig0 still unbound.
- mig_top: mux pack+FEM onto generated mig0 on ui_clk; FEM off CLK100MHZ local dest. Exclusive grant; pack wins. FEM_BASE=28h0200000 bit 21.
- CANDIDATE PROGRAM=NO. Not FEM_PERSIST_PASS / MIG_PASS / BOARD_PASS / TIMING_PASS.
- FEM_MIG_UI32_XSIM_PASS and PACK_MIG_UI32_XSIM_PASS 5/5 are XSim only. 12-bit fold is packing not identity. Do not freeze 7195 ns.
- Live 23/33 17:45 SHA MATCH 10ea7957 / 81f99f4b.
- Canonical FEM persist remains T2 DDR via MIG.

Supersedes A 111323 line that still said FEM dest remains local.
NOT rematched: 105618 085241 084806 072711.
Live 03 still no ACTION_INTENT. SEMANTIC_ID_WIDTH=32. A does not write RTL.
